training.method: Depth-four coach distillation, counterfactual failure relabeling, consistent search values, warm-started distance auxiliary readout

paired_evaluation.protocol: 12 spawned CPU actors, batched GPU inference by model; same 128 simulations per action and unchanged Easy opponent for both models

interpretation: Paired small benchmark: old 3/12, new 7/12; original eight games old 3/8, new 6/8. Includes individual regressions; not an Elo estimate.
